subject: Re: Tuesday appointment
text: Hey, yeah, I saw your note. Honestly, this week's shifted a bit. My daughter's choir thing popped up, and I decided that counts as a big deal now, haha. Could we push the appointment to late afternoon Thursday? I'm good after four. If not, no sweat, but I'd rather not squeeze it between errands. Thanks for being flexible! I appreciate you accommodating me last time too.
